Titles.jpn: キノの旅 何かをするために -life goes on.-

Summaries.eng: Young Kino is being trained by her teacher. She learns how to ride her motorrad Hermes and develops her gift of excellent marksmanship. However, her guilt concerning the real Kino is with her when she decides to set off on a journey. All the while, Kino is becoming confused about her real identity.

Aliases: Kino no Tabi: Nanika o Suru Tame ni - Life Goes On.
Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World -Nanika wo Suru Tame ni- Life Goes On.
Kino's Journey: In Order to Do Something - Life Goes On
